regime_context: Absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically in this market (mean-reverting), so trend discipline alone offers no validated edge; the detector is experimental here. Only 6 of 22 themes are eligible, with Semiconductors leading and AI Compute & Optics close behind; rotation is narrowing, no one-narrative dominance. Innovative Pharma & CXO shows high durability but is crowded.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Despite the gate's poor history, Semiconductors displays the strongest eligible momentum and trend-health (hurst=trend, durability 0.57), and is not crowded; it may maintain relative leadership in a mean-reverting environment, though conviction is low given the detector's experimental status.
theses.dissent: The market is prone to mean-reversion and breadth is not high; momentum may reverse quickly, causing underperformance.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors' rank falls below AI Compute & Optics, or durability drops below 0.50 within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: As the closest challenger to the leader with still-positive momentum, no crowding, and eligibility, it could benefit if rotation persists; however, mixed hurst and low breadth warrant only a modest lean.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag and low breadth (0.235) signal fragile trend health, making a reversal to underperformance likely.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics falls below rank 3 or durability drops below 0.40 within 15 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: While durability is the highest (0.85, trend), the theme is crowded (crowding_z=1.29) and the market's mean-reverting nature raises the risk that this crowded trend stalls; the absolute-trend gate provided no edge, so pure trend-following is not a reason to hold. Avoid is a cautionary stance.
evidence: gate_helps=false, backtest verifies trend-gate did not help here
theses.dissent: High durability may mean the trend persists despite crowding if fundamental drivers remain intact; historical mean-reversion does not guarantee reversal.

falsifier.text: Crowding_z falls below 0.50 while score remains in top 3 within 20 trading days.
